findings.title: Student alternative can plausibly escape the adult age requirement
findings.exactQuote: (2) tiene al menos 18 años, y es residente sin beca, o es estudiante que cumple al menos una de estas dos condiciones: ser miembro, o no tener beca.

findings.intendedAdultMeaning: age >=18 AND ((resident AND NOT scholarship) OR (student AND (member OR NOT scholarship)))
findings.plausibleLooseAdultReading: (age >=18 AND resident AND NOT scholarship) OR (student AND (member OR NOT scholarship))
findings.explanation: The generated Spanish drops the explicit either/or grouping that scopes age18+ over both alternatives. Numbering the adult branch does not itself bind the age conjunct across its internal or. The comma before “o es estudiante” permits loose coordination. An intended grouped reading remains possible, so this is ambiguity rather than an established unequivocal mistranslation.
